v1.0.0.README.md:
# Object storage

Creates one S3 bucket.

## Variables

- bucket_name (string, required): Name of the S3 bucket.
- force_destroy (bool, default false): Allow Terraform to delete the bucket even when it contains objects.

## Outputs

- bucket_id: ID of the created S3 bucket.

# Object storage

Creates one S3 bucket.

## Variables

- bucket_name (string, required): Name of the S3 bucket.
- force_destroy (bool, default false): Allow Terraform to delete the bucket even when it contains objects.
- kms_key_arn (string, required): ARN of the KMS key that encrypts the bucket. Applying this module rebuilds the bucket.

## Outputs

- bucket_id: ID of the created S3 bucket.
